item.title: Make My Photo Look Professional

turns.text: Make me look professional in this photo.

item.tests: Uses reasonable defaults for a vague professional portrait request without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: The portrait shows the same man, retaining his short grey hair and recognisable facial features.
His casual T-shirt is replaced with professional clothing such as a collared shirt or blazer.
The kitchen setting is replaced or simplified into an unobtrusive professional backdrop.
Harsh facial lighting is softened while retaining realistic skin texture.
The result is a clean head-and-shoulders portrait without visible editing artifacts.

turns.text: Make me look professional in this photo.
turns.agent: I'll edit the portrait into a professional headshot with a plain dark blazer and neutral studio background, keeping his face, expression and hair unchanged.

plan.say: I'll edit the portrait into a professional headshot with a plain dark blazer and neutral studio background, keeping his face, expression and hair unchanged.

params.extra: Preserve the original aspect ratio and framing.
params.prompt_or_change: Make this man look professional: change his clothing to a plain dark blazer and the background to a neutral studio backdrop, with polished natural portrait lighting; keep his face, expression, smile if present, hair and likeness unchanged, and retain the original pose and framing.

steps.why: Change the supplied portrait's professional styling while retaining the man's identity.
